name: greymatter
description: GreyMatter — a persistent, growing knowledge trunk for command-line agents.

plugins.name: greymatter
plugins.description: A memory that grows. What you work out once is distilled into a note, filed, linked, and handed back when you ask for it — from any project. No telemetry, and no request of its own: the notes your agent recalls or reads travel with your prompts to your model provider, like the rest of your message.
